chapter: Mexico trip and Charlie Tolles band
title: Trip to Mexico in 1926
summary: He went to Mexico in 1926 for three and a half months with Charlie Tolles's band, played with a white band under Professor Connett and a small four-piece group, then returned to his job.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: When did he go to Mexico? Ask him about that trip.

So when did you go to Mexico? I went to Mexico in 1926. I stayed over there three months and a half. I paid with a white band over there. I paid with a 110. Professor Connett, that's what his name was. And I got scared of him. I thought I couldn't hear the word. But I'm sure were the places where he was the same thing. I'd say, I'd say, they're the same as A, B, C, D, you know. But I got along good with him. I played with him about twice over there. Then I played with another little four piece band over there. Just all little jobs, you know, paid with him. But my band wasn't doing nothing. Whose band was that? Whose band was that in Mexico? It was Charlie Toad. You know what I mean? From your hand. Charlie Toad. He carried us over there. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.

Mm-hm. back there about three months and he died. He went over with us too. Red Island, you see him over there, we used to play together, yeah. That's when I went to Mexico. I cut him to go to Mexico and he told me when I come back my job would be there for me. So when I come back we went together. I couldn't get him to go nowhere. So I threw out here with Faith Martin and then he went to send him to come back. Then he had a break and go to New York. He's been gone ever since.
